folded.id: perfected everything|which|he created and began the creation of man from clay
folded.subject: perfected everything
folded.object: He created and began the creation of man from clay

spans.text: [7] AR: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٍۢ EN: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

folded.id: posterity out|of|the extract of a liquid disdained
folded.subject: posterity out
folded.object: the extract of a liquid disdained

spans.text: [8] AR: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ EN: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

folded.id: refuge is|the|fire
folded.subject: refuge is

spans.text: [20] AR: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ EN: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire.

folded.id: so will|you|not be reminded?
folded.subject: so will

spans.text: You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

folded.id: that is|the|knower of the unseen and the witnessed
folded.subject: That is
folded.object: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed

spans.text: [6] AR: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ EN: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

folded.id: that|you|may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided
folded.subject: that
folded.object: may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided

spans.text: Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

folded.id: the angel|of|death will take you who has been entrusted with you
folded.subject: The angel
folded.object: death will take you who has been entrusted with you

spans.text: [11] AR: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ EN: Say, "The angel of death will take you who has been entrusted with you.

folded.id: the exalted|in|might
folded.subject: the Exalted

spans.text: [6] AR: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ EN: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

folded.id: the extent|of|which is a thousand years of those which you count
folded.subject: the extent
folded.object: which is a thousand years of those which you count

spans.text: [5] AR: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ EN: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

folded.id: the revelation|of|the book about which there is no doubt from the lord of the worlds
folded.subject: the revelation
folded.object: the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds

spans.text: [2] AR: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

folded.id: their lord|in|fear and aspiration
folded.subject: their Lord

spans.text: [16] AR: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ EN: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

folded.id: then it|will|ascend to him in a day
folded.subject: then it
folded.object: ascend to Him in a Day

spans.text: [5] AR: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ EN: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

folded.id: they|will|be returned to it while it is said to them
folded.subject: they
folded.object: be returned to it while it is said to them

spans.text: Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."

folded.id: those believe|in|our verses who
folded.subject: those believe

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩ EN: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

folded.id: to|the|world]
folded.subject: to

spans.text: [12] AR: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ EN: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness.

folded.id: we drive|the|water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves?
folded.subject: We drive
folded.object: water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves?

spans.text: [27] AR: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ EN: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves?

folded.id: we made|the|torah guidance for the children of israel
folded.subject: we made
folded.object: Torah guidance for the Children of Israel

spans.text: And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.

folded.id: we|will|work righteousness
folded.subject: we

spans.text: [12] AR: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ EN: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness.

folded.id: when|will|be this conquest
folded.subject: When

spans.text: [28] AR: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

folded.id: your lord|will|judge between them on the day of resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

spans.text: [25] AR: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ EN: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

folded.id: your lord|you|will be returned
folded.subject: your Lord

spans.text: Then to your Lord you will be returned."
